title: Milanese embassy at Buda, 1489-91: Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher and the abbot of Forli's (ASMi Sforzesco 642/645/650)

steps.what: Somogyi 2016 key and cipher/clear pairs; Vestigia API and DECODE records located; clear copies found for R1155 and R1147.
Segmentation and agent transcription of R1098, 267 and 2831 p. 1 strips; several agents lost to the rate limit.
Somogyi's numbers follow first occurrence in 267, so aligning 267 with its clear extract 268 pins glyphs to values; 267 decodes almost verbatim.
R1098 read in gist, all ten cipher lines.
R1098 ll. 7-10 restate the letter's clear page 2.
2831 ll. 1-2 reproduce Somogyi's printed decipherment exactly.
22 Nov 1489 letter read across all four pages, new sign values gained along the way.
Framing corrected: 'nobody had deciphered' becomes 'no published decipherment'; Somogyi held the key and printed a specimen of the letter.

Reclassified from 'read' to 'read in part': no measured share of signs read; page 3 of the 1489 letter after l. 19 read only in patches (about a third of its words), four signs unvalued, R1098 ll. 5, 6, 9 short groups open. NOTES gain Remaining gaps and Escalation sections; next step is a full token transcription and a measured count.
DECODE R1098, R1146, R1147, R1158 refetched with the login cookie: no DOC transcriptions on any record, images only.

Abbot of Forli's key recovered from R1147: its cipher words aligned with the clear extract (Labancz no. 45); simple substitution with word signs (abbot_key.md). Control: cipher 'dicere' where the extract paraphrases 'fingere'; the address decodes 'Domino Mafeo Triviliensi'.
Vestigia 591/592 (ms. 4936) and 2242 (ASMi 645, misattributed to Bartolini 1492) identified as clear copies of R1146; its date is 16 Sept 1491, not 16 Oct.

R1146 pp. 1-3 deciphered by agents with the recovered key, line by line, checked against 2242/591: 868 words, 829 from the key, 39 word signs and single signs valued from the copy, none unread; new values (tt, ff, ss, mm, cc, rr, z, j, homophones for o, i, n).
Print search: MDE IV (Nagy & Nyary 1878) no. 91 prints R1098 in clear; MDE IV has no 22 Nov 1489 despatch; Berzeviczy 1914 prints only the 18 Nov 1491 abbot letter.

R1098's 18 Sept reading compared with the print: 75 of 108 words matched in sequence (69%); the 'Tulln' conjecture was wrong ('a tutti li luoghi ove ha fatta edificare'); the sign transcription fits the print; 7 = f, dotted b = ca, m with two slashes = ss.
2831 p. 3 retry on slope-corrected row crops: the page has 31 lines (the segmentation had merged ll. 28-31); all re-read; x-macron = ma gives q^s x-macron = Roma, n^u = rr, crossed b + r = fa.
Share read: 2831 87.5-89.9% of about 4,262 signs (estimate, measure_read.py); R1098 455/469 signs; R1146 829/868 words from the key (measure_r1146.py).
R1158 (1492, to Maffeo) inspected: a third cipher with a partial interlinear gloss on the address; no clear copy found; not attempted further.

outcome.method_basis: Somogyi 2016 published the key of Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher in numeric form; it was tied to the glyphs here by aligning Vestigia 267 with its clear extract 268 and then applied to the 22 Nov 1489 letter and DECODE R1098, gaining some new sign values. 9 Oct 2026: R1146 (abbot of Forli) deciphered with a key recovered from R1147's adjacent clear extract; R1098 found printed (MDE IV no. 91).
outcome.notes: Read in part: 2831 (no decipherment) about 87.5-89.9% of signs, below the 95% bar, p. 2 ll. 17-32 not yet retried. R1098 is printed (MDE IV no. 91) and 97% of its signs now have a value. R1146 deciphered in full with the abbot's key recovered here from R1147; it was read at the time (clear copy Vestigia 2242).

gaps.item: 2831 p. 1 ll. 21-26, last words of each line
gaps.detail: stain at the right edge; Vestigia's is the only image

gaps.item: 2831 p. 3 faint runs at the line ends of ll. 6, 7, 25, 29-31
gaps.detail: ink too faint at about 25 px per sign; retried 9 Oct on row crops

gaps.item: 2831 p. 3, about 25 short runs with clear signs that give no word
gaps.detail: each holds a sign without a value or fits no Italian word; listed in trans/v2831p3_retry.md

gaps.item: 2831 nomenclator signs (madonna Bianca, zo. Corvino, vescovo varadino, the lone crossed b, the capital R)
gaps.detail: met once or twice each, not in Somogyi's table
not yet retried with the 9 Oct sign values

gaps.item: R1098 l. 10, about 14 faded fragments after 'spassando'
gaps.detail: faded tail; the printed extract stops before it

gaps.item: R1146 word signs valued only from the clear copy (vescovo Javriense, sua Maesta and others)
gaps.detail: abbot's nomenclator, no key sheet; values fixed by the contemporary decipherment

outcome.fraction_read_source: measure_read.py --strict on v2831_reading.md (2831, the despatch with no decipherment; cipher signs, [..]/[?] unread); measured separately: R1098 0.970 of 469 signs, R1146 0.955 of 868 words from the key (1.0 with the copy's word signs)

credits.note: 2016 numeric key and lines 1-2 of the 22 Nov 1489 letter; tied to the signs and extended here
clear extract Vestigia 268 and R1098 p. 2 clear text, used to calibrate the signs
